title: USER VERIFICATION (NEXUS TRUST)
syntheticNote: Your identity is protected by purpose-specific consent and an encrypted vault.
consentLabel: I consent to this verification step and its minimum identity evidence.
otpConsent: I consent to the OTP verification step.
manualLabel: Use officer-assisted verification without ABC/APAAR or SSO
otpNote: Enter the verification code. During the Guided Walkthrough, use its verification-code step.
error: The request could not be completed. Please check your input and access, then try again.
legalNote: Consent withdrawal is recorded without deleting the ledger. Retention is not available: no approved retention policy.
fraudNote: Signals route to human review. They never auto-reject a grievance.
revealNote: A different authorized person must approve. Only the requester may view the identity until expiry. Bureau access requires a configured case-scope adapter.
name: Name
backupNote: BackupSimulator produces a manifest only; it is not a recoverable backup.
failedLogins: Failed login attempts / observed login attempts since reset
fraudSignals: Fraud signals / reporter accounts since reset (multiple signals possible)
emptyInbox: No active OTP. Request a new code on the verification page.
demoOnly: This inbox is available only in the local verification environment.
policyNote: Eligibility and retention require an approved AICTE policy; verification does not invent one.
OTP_INVALID: OTP is incorrect, expired, consumed or attempt-limited.
CONSENT_REQUIRED: Consent is required for this step.
RATE_LIMITED: Request limit reached. Try again after the configured window.
REVEAL_SCOPE_DENIED: Your office is not authorized, or case scope is not configured.
DIFFERENT_APPROVER_REQUIRED: A different authorized person must approve.
MANUAL_REVIEW_PENDING: An officer must complete the pending manual review.
VERIFICATION_NOT_READY: Complete the required verification steps first.
CURRENT_STATUS_INVALID: Current enrolment or employment is not valid for verification.
USER_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This user type does not match your account role.
VAULT_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED: The identity vault key has not been configured.
REVEAL_NOT_ACTIVE: This reveal is not approved or has expired.
retaliationWatchHelp: Optional. The system re-checks your enrolment or employment after a complaint. A change sends a private advisory to the Competent Authority for human review. Withdraw this consent at any time.
NOT_ENROLLED: ID not found in simulated Academic Bank of Credits / APAAR registry.
INACTIVE: Enrolment or employment status is inactive or suspended.
MISMATCH: ID is registered under a different institution than selected.
INVALID_APAAR_FORMAT: Invalid APAAR/ABC ID format. Please enter a 12-digit number.
simulatedCheckBadge: Simulated ABC / APAAR check (local synthetic registry, no external call)
